## Description
Anthropic's draft IPO filing shows an $80.7 billion net loss in six months, yet investors talk about a $2 trillion IPO. One of those numbers is mostly an illusion. The number that could really sink it is a $518 billion bill. Here's what the leaked draft IPO filing actually shows.
